sections.heading: C — Lane choice and turning technique
sections.markdown:
## C — Lane choice and turning technique

FACT_ID: sec05-F01 | anchor: A01
Backing within a travel lane is prohibited except when parallel parking. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F02 | anchor: A01
After missing a turn or exit, continue ahead until a safe place allows you to turn around. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F03 | anchor: A01
Do not stop in a travel lane for confusion, a breakdown or a passenger exit; continue until you can pull off safely. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F04 | anchor: A01
Where at least two lanes carry traffic the same way, use the right lane except when passing. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F05 | anchor: A01
Where at least three lanes carry traffic the same way and entering or exiting vehicles are numerous, use the center travel lane. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F06 | anchor: A01
Use the roadway shoulder only when officials direct you to drive there. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F07 | anchor: A01
On a multilane road, the far-left lane is intended for overtaking slower vehicles. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F08 | anchor: A01
When you overtake on the right, the other driver may have trouble seeing you and could move into your path. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F09 | anchor: A01
Passing on the shoulder is prohibited whether the shoulder is paved or unpaved. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F10 | anchor: A01
When signs or markings do not control a turn, start from the lane nearest the intended direction and enter the lane nearest the one you left. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F11 | anchor: A01
During a turn, take the most direct feasible path between lanes without crossing lane lines or interfering with traffic. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F12 | anchor: A01
After completing a turn, you may change lanes if needed. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F13 | anchor: A01
Signal every turn and every lane change. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-F14 | anchor: A01
Before a right turn, avoid swinging widely to the left. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

Misconceptions: a missed exit does not justify reversing in a travel lane.
Mnemonics: finish the turn, then change lanes if needed.
Glossary: a travel lane carries moving traffic; the shoulder is not a passing lane.
Dynamic facts: lane arrows, posted controls and official directions at the actual road must be checked.

sections.heading: C2 — Lane choice and turning technique
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Lane choice and turning technique

FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A01
A leftward swing before a right turn can make the following driver think you will go left and attempt to pass on your right. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A01
Swinging into a farther lane while completing a right turn can surprise drivers already in that lane. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A02
During a left turn, avoid cutting across the corner into the path of a vehicle approaching from the left. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A02
A left-turning driver must leave enough room for opposing traffic to turn left ahead of the vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A02
When signs or lane markings allow multiple turning lanes, remain within your assigned lane through the turn. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0014]
